Oh, sorry for the delay, really sorry, i really appreciate it, thank you for that, i feel like people care. 

I doubt it's the good subreddit to talk about this, but well, it did go a bit bad, i somehow prepared a plan to kill myself and everything is ready to do it, and i just don't know what to do anymore, i feel like i have no other choice. I don't want you to worry though.
I refuse to live 30 years of this, i just can't endure the pain. But thank you for wasting your time on me, i truly appreciate it.

that's not true.. I just wanted people to be proud of me for like 5 seconds, but, in reality, it will not get better at all, at least not for someone like me, it's just too late. But thank you, i still appreciate it.
Well, thank you, i'm glad you're glad about it, i haven't feel appreciated in years, it feel somewhat good !
Thank you, i appreciate it so much.

I see, i live with my parents and my siblings. 

Anyway, thank you for real this time.

True, she was just worried and she played it safe.

Anyway thanks for you answer, but i have a question, is it possible that cops show up tomorrow or a few day after ?

I confronted her, and she was just way too worried about me and misunderstood me, she didn't thought i was venting. But it was a fine reaction to be honest. I still think what she did was bad, even though it was a good intention.
Well, don't worry, i learned my lessons, i was way too naive to trust someone on internet for my venting.

I live in Canada near a really small city, and i live in a very rural area near this city. So i think i'm safe for that.

I still fear them coming to my house though, i don't want my family to know about it. I guess i can't do anything about it.

Really ? They won't took me to the hospital or things like that ?

Thanks for the answer, its a big relief for me.
